correctness.rationale: For S any four-element F7 set, degree<2 polynomial evaluation gives 49 codewords. Seven constants are conflict-free against nonconstant distinct-symbol supports, so always included. Permute then delete causes two nonconstant codewords to conflict iff their four-symbol value supports share at least 3 symbols (including identical supports); complements are affine images of T=F7\S. AGL(1,7) gives progression/nonprogression 3-subset orbits sizes21 and14 with stabilizers 2 and3. Pairwise-compatible triples must have disjoint 21-bit unordered-pair masks. The finite C++ certificate independently examined all 2^21+2^14 orbit-family subsets and Python independent conflict search reproduced maximum packings of 6 (14 equality families) and 7 (2 equality families). Consequently M(S)=13 or14 and optimal labeled codebook counts 14*2^6=896 or 2*3^7=4374 respectively; exactly 21/14 evaluation sets have these types. All finite candidates are covered, not sampled.
